g.text: Protocol changes create measurable feasibility trade-offs

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: 'Enrolment +10%' raises the chance of meeting the trial objectives from 58% to 97%, at the cost of 20 more patients with a serious AE.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #222222

g.text: Teal: more favourable than the original protocol · Orange: greater feasibility burden · Grey: within 3% of the original, or descriptive
